date-tvdb.reason: AniDB 1 'Complete Movie' (MOVIE, 1995-07-15) -> TVDB S0E1 'Ninku the Movie'. Same film. TVDB's 1996-01-01 is a year placeholder; the film aired 1995-07-15 (the 'suggested target' S1E27 'The Valley and Fuusui' is just a TV episode of the same date). The other two S0 entries (E2 'Ninku: Knife no Bohyou', E3 its 'Super Secret Video') belong to AniDB 3209. Side finding: 3209 'Ninkuu: Knife no Bohyou' is published with defaulttvdbseason 0 and no offset, so it also lands on S0E1 and collides with this film; it needs episodeoffset 1 (E2). It is not a lead in the date check.
